llm_fields.description: Accident Assistance is a welfare scheme for registered construction workers of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board in Karnataka, providing compensation from both the employer and the Board when a worker suffers an accident during employment.
llm_fields.eligibility: The applicant must be a registered building/construction worker (unorganised worker) aged at least 18 years, who has engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a year, and the accident must occur during the course of employment or outside of work.
